ref_sources: SS Antilla, about 12.6021 N, 70.0578 W, roughly 700 m west of Malmok. The German freighter lies on her port side, broken amidships, bow toward the beach; the real wreck is fully submerged, but this sea is opaque, so the upper rail, a bridge block and the masts break the surface and the yellow mooring buoys sit off the starboard side. Yellow with a white band is the usual Caribbean mooring-buoy colour.
